name: Industry off-take (sales)
definition: Total fertilizer product sales by all industry participants for the period (YTD current vs prior year).
formula: Σ industry sales of product, Jan → reporting month
source: Industry Overview E9:F18 ← Dashboard Query Sheet1 E47:F50
notes: Workbook holds YTD only; monthly industry history accumulates as months are published.

name: FG off-take
definition: Fatima Group sales volume by product for the period.
formula: Σ FG SKU lines per product (Urea = 2 lines, CAN = 2 lines)
source: FG Details F10:H28 ← Dashboard Query Sheet1 E57:F71
notes: FG CAN equals industry CAN (FG is the only CAN producer in the workbook).

name: FG share of industry sales
definition: FG off-take ÷ industry off-take for the same product(s) and period.
formula: Σ FG YTD ÷ Σ industry YTD
notes: Industry-basis share. Not comparable with the tracked-set share used on the geographic page.

name: Planned vs achieved (YTD)
definition: YTD achieved volume ÷ YTD planned volume for months up to the reporting month.
source: FG Details charts "Planned vs Achieved – …" ← Dashboard Query Sheet1 K4:W20
notes: Future months are Missing (not planned), never 0. "Achieved" ≠ industry off-take: see REC-10.

name: Market price (monthly average)
definition: Monthly average price per bag by series and price type (DTP, Trade, Retail/farmer).
formula: Workbook monthly average; MoM = cur ÷ prev − 1; YoY = cur ÷ same month last year − 1
source: Market Prices I61:U84 ← Dashboard Query Sheet1 K25:W62
notes: Sona = FFC brand, Sarsabz (SS) = FG brand (inferred). Unit assumed PKR per 50 kg bag.

name: Sarsabz vs Sona price gap
definition: FG brand price minus FFC brand price for the same commodity and price type.

name: Commodity price YoY
definition: National average farm-gate/wholesale price for a crop, YTD current vs YTD prior year.
notes: Interpretation (purchasing power) is analytical, not a fact.

name: Market share (industry basis)
definition: Company share of industry sales by product group; 2021–2025, YTD-2025, YTD-2026.
source: Market Share charts ← Dashboard Query Sheet1 AH21:AO70
notes: Groups: TOTAL, UREA, DAP, NP, NITROGEN, PHOSPHATE.

name: FG share by geography (tracked set)
definition: FG share within the tracked competitive set (FFC + Engro + FG) for Nitrogen (Urea + CAN) or Phosphate (DAP + NP) at zone/region/district level.
formula: (FG primary + FG secondary) ÷ (FFC + Engro + FG primary + FG secondary)
source: Dis. Wise Share ← District Wise Market Shares.xlsx
notes: Different basis from industry market share: always label which one is shown.

name: DAP import pipeline
definition: Vessel lines of DAP imports by buyer, supplier, quantity, origin, departure, CFR and arrival; status derived against an as-of date.
formula: Σ qty (000 MT); weighted CFR = Σ(CFR×qty) ÷ Σ qty; status by dates vs as-of
source: DAP Vessels H17:P49 ← Dashboard Query Sheet1 J134:S154
notes: Workbook average CFR is an unweighted mean of lines; Data Center shows quantity-weighted.

name: BG / E-BG / DCF volumes
definition: Value of bank guarantees (manual + electronic) and dealer-credit-facility orders from the cached transaction extracts.
formula: BG = Σ BG Amount over distinct BG numbers; DCF = Σ ORDER VALUE of populated rows
validation: REC-16, REC-17, PER-05, PER-06, DUP-02, DUP-03
notes: Workbook BG pivot is single-region and stops at June; Data Center computes from the full cache.

name: Data quality score
definition: Weighted share of validation rules that pass (errors ×3, warnings ×1, info ×0).
formula: Σ weight(passed rules) ÷ Σ weight(all non-skipped rules)
notes: Publishing is blocked while any error-severity rule fails.
